Name: Weeds
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
By default:

[list]
[*]weeds will prevent crop growth if left to grow to full (can disable this in the config)
[*]weeding provides 1 farming experience and costs 1 energy per weed (can be changed or disabled in config)
[*]weed grow at least 1% and at most 25% per day (can be changed in config)
[*]weeding does not improve crop growth (can be enabled in the config)
[*]weeds are slightly brown in color (color tint can be changed in the config)
[/list]
Weed sprite can be edited using CP targetting the path "[b]aedenthorn.Weeds/weed[/b]".

Supports GMCM for easy configuration.
